strings.Choice.Hearthward.FortifiedCrossing: Station League guards outside the grove and guarantee the public bypass.
strings.Choice.Hearthward.SharedPassage: Witness shared passage with the Briarbound and protect the marked grove.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N01.Alternative: Explain what the League expects of me.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N01.Line: The ledger records your allegiance to the Hearthward League. This is not membership in Vesa’s Hearth Assembly. Your class and vocation remain separate.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N01.Primary: A road is worth defending when people can use it. Record my pledge.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N01.Response: Your allegiance is already permanent. We ask you to keep people supplied and account for the cost of expansion. You may question our officers without changing who you are.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N02.Alternative: Show me an ordinary supply contract.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N02.Line: I teach through the Hearth Assembly, not the League. Every traveler needs food, tools and a way home.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N02.Primary: Show me the work available to my vocation.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q01.N02.Response: Both routes remain open. Specialist training belongs to your active vocation; basic work and the story do not.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N01.Alternative: I will clear the sentries and search the cart.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N01.Line: A cart bound for the north crossing did not arrive. Its provisions matter, but I am more worried about the copied inscription in its chest.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N01.Primary: I will follow the wheel tracks and speak to the witness.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N01.Response: Either route can establish what happened. Bring the broken seal, not a rumor.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N02.Alternative: Tell me how to recover supplies without fighting.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N02.Line: Return what can be used. We will feed the crew before arguing over who owns the road.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N02.Primary: The cart is found. Here is the authenticated manifest.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q02.N02.Response: Read the axle marks, examine the abandoned chest and use the reed-bank path. No one needs to face a patrol alone.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N01.Alternative: A supply road also protects families who cannot wait.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N01.Line: Your maps call these roots empty ground. My family has tended the crossing since before Thornmere kept a ledger.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N01.Primary: Then the road agreement needs your consent.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N01.Response: Both are true. Someone drove iron markers into the roots after our meeting. Look at the knot cut into them.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N02.Alternative: Tell Maren why the disturbance is dangerous.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N02.Line: This knot is not a clan sign. The Hollow Covenant has copied part of a waystone warning and reversed its order.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N02.Primary: Record the evidence, not an accusation against the clans.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q03.N02.Response: I will record both. The old warnings describe a depth below the roads. We do not yet know what the Deepweal is.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N01.Alternative: Give me the free public supply contract.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N01.Line: North Road needs twelve units of accepted work. Your own ledger needs three. If the bridge already stands, maintenance still counts for you without rebuilding it.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N01.Primary: Show the work for my vocation.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N01.Response: The Roadward Accord accepts equivalent work. A basic inspection and delivery can earn all twelve units without a specialist, a market or another player.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N02.Alternative: Explain how late arrivals can contribute.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N02.Line: A repaired crossing is not permission to take every tree beside it. Put the limits in writing.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N02.Primary: Record the work and preserve the boundary markers.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q04.N02.Response: Inspect and maintain what stands. Their own receipts record their work; old builders keep their history.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N01.Alternative: Fortified crossing: station League guards outside the grove and guarantee a public bypass.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N01.Line: The League wants your recommendation. It will remain in your journal. The realm’s public compact is resolved separately and may choose differently.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N01.Primary: Shared passage: witness access with the Briarbound and forbid cutting the marked grove.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N01.Response: Neither choice closes essential travel or authorizes attacks on rival players. You cannot rewrite your personal recommendation after it is committed.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N02.Alternative: Let the record show a defended road with an open bypass.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N02.Line: I will remember what you signed, even if the realm chooses another policy.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N02.Primary: Let the record show shared passage.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q05.N02.Response: A promise has meaning only when the people at the crossing can see it kept.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N01.Alternative: Teach me the three inscriptions so we can quiet the signal.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N01.Line: The Split Bell answers a signal that no living keeper sent. The Covenant is feeding the pattern. We can break its focus or restore the warning sequence.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N01.Primary: I will confront the briar-struck sentries with your assistance.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N01.Response: Both paths reveal the same warning. The bell scene can be begun now; you do not have to wait for real dusk.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N02.Alternative: What remains here after I leave?
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N02.Line: Your report changes the work ahead. Thornmere cannot solve this by extending another survey line. Carry Eren’s rubbing to Bellroot.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N02.Primary: Record my choice and issue guest passage to Elderwood.
strings.Dialogue.Hearthward.Q06.N02.Response: The construction, your contribution and your personal choices remain. Bellroot can receive you through the common camp, whatever the latest crossing policy.
strings.Dialogue.eren.Warning: The Veil Survey studies the waystones for every community. Bring evidence before assigning blame; the disturbance reaches beyond any one faction.
strings.Dialogue.hearthward.Arrival: Welcome to Thornmere. Your allegiance to the Hearthward League is already recorded. I will explain the road charter and the people it affects.
strings.Dialogue.talan.Crossing: I speak for the families tending the marked grove. We will hear a proposal for passage, but the grove is not empty land.
strings.Dialogue.vesa.Intro: The Hearth Assembly teaches every traveler the basics. Your chosen vocation grants specialist training; your political allegiance does not remove access to food, tools or recovery.
strings.Faction.FutureContentUnavailable: This faction is not available for new characters. Its campaign and starting content are still in production.
